name: Flat mushroom
summary: Flat mushroom: a brown button mushroom or a red toadstool with white spots, for forest and vegetable scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the item rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~350 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: variant
params.note: button = brown cap, toadstool = red cap with white spots

params.name: color
params.note: cap colour for button (toadstool is always red)

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in

author: krakujs
